# ADLC5

> ADLC5 is a public-preview AI coding delivery workflow for software repositories. It connects Specify, Plan, Tasks, and Implement through repository intelligence and current evidence.

Workflow contracts are tested. Comparative coding-quality results and outside-contributor qualification remain pending. See the [home page](https://adlc5.dev/) and [completion limits](https://adlc5.dev/lifecycle/#what-completion-establishes) before making readiness claims.

## Documentation

- [Home](https://adlc5.dev/): ADLC5's purpose, five pillars, and recommended starting path.
- [Installation](https://adlc5.dev/installation/): host prerequisites, setup, and verification.
- [Quickstart](https://adlc5.dev/quickstart/): initialize a consumer repository and start a feature.
- [Walkthrough](https://adlc5.dev/walkthrough/): an illustrative end-to-end feature example.
- [Lifecycle](https://adlc5.dev/lifecycle/): Specify → Plan → Tasks → Implement and evidence-backed completion.
- [Intelligence](https://adlc5.dev/intelligence/): repository maps, reviewed guidance, focused context, and freshness evidence.
- [Running agents](https://adlc5.dev/running/): supervised host execution modes and result handling.
- [Troubleshooting](https://adlc5.dev/support/): common setup and gate issues, questions, and bug reports.
- [Releases](https://adlc5.dev/releases/): release notes, upgrade path, and support boundaries.
- [Reference](https://adlc5.dev/reference/): canonical repository guides, kernel commands, and project overview.

The [XML sitemap](https://adlc5.dev/sitemap.xml) lists the published documentation pages. The [source repository](https://github.com/dango-tech/adlc5) contains implementation and framework contracts.
